candidates.name: Chronology-aware Same-Side Session Loss Permission

candidates.entry_permission: deny F05 Entry only when both conditions hold
candidates.information_time: completed M15 H4 and D1 bars available at Entry

candidates.continuation_failure: at first M15 observation close when current_pips<0 and MFE<0.25*Entry_ATR
candidates.giveback: at any M15 observation close when MFE>=1.00*Entry_ATR and current_pips<=0.25*Entry_ATR
candidates.information_time: observed Tick path summarized at completed M15 lifecycle observations and Entry-time ATR
candidates.name: Entry-ATR Continuation Failure and Giveback Lifecycle

combined_candidate.authorization_rule: authorized only if both C1 and C3 preserve positive 2023-2024 net, each retains at least 80 percent of baseline historical net, and affected-trade overlap is at most 25 percent; authorization uses 2023-2024 outcomes only before combined 2025H1 evaluation
